piezas.titular: Google offered Opal for building apps without coding; a year later it has shut it down
piezas.entradilla: In November 2025, Google offered Opal for free, a tool for building apps with AI without knowing how to code. It shut it down on 17 November 2026, and what people made with it does not move to Gemini on its own.
cuerpo: On 23 November 2025, in Vibe Coding Educativo, a Google post in Spanish was shared that presented Opal as a way to “create your own apps with AI, without knowing how to code”. That same day, someone was still asking how to view the code of an HTML file. Opal promised to skip that step: all you had to do was describe the app.

In December, Google brought it to the Gemini app as an experimental Gem, a customised Gemini assistant, according to [its blog](https://blog.google/technology/google-labs/mini-apps-opal-gemini-app-experiment/). A year later it no longer exists: according to the [Opal FAQ](https://developers.google.com/opal/faq), Google shut it down on 17 November 2026 and says its function has moved to Gemini Skills, saved instructions that you invoke by typing “/” and their name.

The move is not automatic. Gems become Skills on their own, as the paper reported with [the renaming of EduGems to EduPrompts](pieza:2026-11-10/edugems-eduprompts), but Opal apps no longer work and shared ones will not open. Their files remain in Google Drive with the original *prompts*, which can be copied into a new Skill; Opal could chain instructions, web searches and images or video in a single app. Teachers who used it in class will have to recreate them as Skills.

piezas.comprobado: Mensaje #6834 de vceduca comprobado en t.me (23-11-2025): enlaza la publicación de Google en español sobre Opal gratuita; la pregunta sobre ver el código HTML es de #6827 (23-11-2025, 00:06). Preguntas frecuentes oficiales de Opal: opal.google cerrado el 17-11-2026; «Opal has graduated to skills in Gemini»; las skills se invocan con «/» y su nombre; los Gems pasan solos; los Opals ya no funcionan y los compartidos no se abren; los archivos siguen en My Drive > Opal; un Opal encadenaba prompts, búsqueda web e imagen o vídeo. Blog de Google del 17-12-2025: Opal llega a la app de Gemini para crear Gems experimentales. Enlace pieza:2026-11-10/edugems-eduprompts presente en publicado.txt y sobre Gems→Skills. Tema no repetido en «Ya contado». No se da fecha de lanzamiento de las skills.
repaso: Quitada la frase «no cabe tal cual en ella», que ninguna fuente respalda; sustituida por lo que dice la FAQ (Opal encadenaba instrucciones, búsquedas web e imágenes o vídeo).
Última frase: «rehacer sus aplicaciones» pasa a «recrearlas como Skills», más cercano a la FAQ.
Lo demás, comprobado y sin cambios. 240 palabras.
